start.speaker: judge
start.text: Court is now in session. The matter before the court is the State versus Griffy.

node_7627845f9e.speaker: judge
node_7627845f9e.text: Mr. Griffy, you are charged with the attempted murder on Tracy Stakes.

node_57999573e1.speaker: prosecutor
node_57999573e1.text: Your Honor, the prosecution is prepared to proceed.

node_b564867f02.speaker: judge
node_b564867f02.text: Very well. The plea of not guilty is entered into the record.

node_349ad1f934.speaker: judge
node_349ad1f934.text: Mr. Griffy, are you pleading guilty?

node_7760f6c6f9.speaker: judge
node_7760f6c6f9.text: The court has heard the evidence and considered the arguments presented by both sides.

node_2a4dce4a56.speaker: judge
node_2a4dce4a56.text: On the charge of attempted murder, this court finds you...

node_d73b48cef8.speaker: defendant
node_d73b48cef8.text: The defense is also prepared, Your Honor.

node_d56a0fb6b9.speaker: defendant
node_d56a0fb6b9.text: Objection, Your honour. My client is mute.

node_49af59a716.speaker: prosecutor
node_49af59a716.text: Wait, weren't you speaking all this time?

node_a538d09f0a.speaker: prosecutor
node_a538d09f0a.text: Your Honor, the prosecution would like to submit surveillance footage from the night of the incident as evidence.

node_fb99f13fc5.speaker: judge
node_fb99f13fc5.text: Counsel for the prosecution, you may give your opening statement.

node_01097c20e1.speaker: prosecutor
node_01097c20e1.text:
Thank you, Your Honor. Ladies and gentlemen of the jury, the evidence
will show that the defendant, Mr. Griffy, deliberately attempted to murder Tracy Stakes on the evening of March 14th.

node_c07b04dc70.speaker: prosecutor
node_c07b04dc70.text: You will hear testimony from eyewitnesses who were present at the scene. You will also see CCTV footage showing the defendant following Ms. Stakes shortly before the attack.

node_f84e3b895f.speaker: prosecutor
node_f84e3b895f.text: The evidence will demonstrate that this was not an accident or a misunderstanding. The defendant had the opportunity, the means, and the intent to cause Ms. Stakes serious harm.

node_7ff8f6d210.speaker: character_3940b014c1
node_7ff8f6d210.text:
Filename: ai_generated_video_20250314_2142.mp4
Location: West Entrance - Stakes Building
Date: March 14, 2025
Time: 9:42 PM

node_683d5a2ab7.speaker: prosecutor
node_683d5a2ab7.text: The footage directly places the defendant at the scene shortly before the attack.

node_4524679fc4.speaker: judge
node_4524679fc4.text: Overruled. The evidence may be presented.

node_66e10f2bf9.speaker: prosecutor
node_66e10f2bf9.text: Your Honor, the prosecution maintains that the defendant's actions were deliberate.

node_bdf3b26b52.speaker: defendant
node_bdf3b26b52.text: Objection. The prosecution is ignoring a rather important fact about my client.

node_bf0596bb3a.speaker: judge
node_bf0596bb3a.text: And what fact would that be?

node_00ce438269.speaker: defendant
node_00ce438269.text: My client is mentally challenged, Your Honor.

node_b601875a34.speaker: judge
node_b601875a34.text: Counsel, what evidence do you have to support this claim?

options.text: I have never seen those in my life.

node_65ba5e609a.speaker: judge
node_65ba5e609a.text: Very well. Let me see the documents.

options.text: That's not a real medical document.

node_7240177d02.speaker: defendant
node_7240177d02.text: Your Honor, the defense submits Exhibit F: the defendant's medical records.

node_c804e6ee70.speaker: prosecutor
node_c804e6ee70.text: The prosecution moves to have Exhibit F rejected on grounds of authenticity.

node_8f3c0b8e7e.speaker: judge
node_8f3c0b8e7e.text: Sustained. Exhibit F will not be admitted.

node_968d72f64c.speaker: prosecutor
node_968d72f64c.text: Your Honor, the prosecution objects to the authenticity of Exhibit F.

node_d613dfc410.speaker: judge
node_d613dfc410.text: Sustained. Exhibit F will not be admitted.

node_03d36aafed.speaker: judge
node_03d36aafed.text: And that is precisely what concerns the court.

node_7a33d60193.speaker: judge
node_7a33d60193.text: Your Honor, my client seems to be mistaken. The footage is clearly authentic.

node_bc0838cd2d.speaker: prosecutor
node_bc0838cd2d.text: The defense agrees that the footage is admissible.

node_c9c01634f0.speaker: judge
node_c9c01634f0.text: Then the objection is overruled. Continue.

node_ee55935e4c.speaker: prosecutor
node_ee55935e4c.text: The footage was recovered from a security camera outside the building.

node_b5b74cd9a3.speaker: defendant
node_b5b74cd9a3.text: Your Honor, we have no reason to dispute the prosecution's claim.

node_39e80ef550.speaker: prosecutor
node_39e80ef550.text: The prosecution calls its next witness.

node_c70ac3cd44.speaker: character_acaf30b3c9
node_c70ac3cd44.text: I heard this angry, panicked man screaming from Room 501, like he had completely lost control. He was yelling horrible threats, followed by a loud crash that made the whole wall shake.

node_6263a058f6.speaker: judge
node_6263a058f6.text: The claim of muteness is not supported by the defendant's own testimony. It will be disregarded.

node_cbb14d6e91.speaker: judge
node_cbb14d6e91.text: And there it is again. The defendant continues to speak.

node_cf10e5fab7.speaker: judge
node_cf10e5fab7.text: The defendant has been verbally answering questions throughout the proceedings. Continued silence does not make the claim credible.
